description: This file defines the EventHubQueueCache class, which manages a cache of EventHub messages for Orleans streaming, including adding messages, managing cache pressure, handling purges, and interfacing with other components like eviction strategies and checkpoints.

classes.name: EventHubQueueCache
classes.description: Manages a cache of EventHub messages for Orleans streaming, including adding messages, cache pressure management, and purging.

methods.name: EventHubQueueCache
methods.description: Constructor to initialize the queue cache with configuration parameters and dependencies.

methods.name: SignalPurge
methods.description: Triggers cache eviction based on the eviction strategy.

methods.name: AddCachePressureMonitor
methods.description: Adds a cache pressure monitor to the cache's back pressure management.

methods.name: Dispose
methods.description: Cleans up resources and unregisters event handlers.

methods.name: GetMaxAddCount
methods.description: Returns the maximum number of items that can be added to the cache, considering current pressure.

methods.name: Add
methods.description: Adds a list of EventData messages to the cache and returns their corresponding stream positions.

methods.name: GetCursor
methods.description: Provides a cursor for reading messages from the cache.

methods.name: TryGetNextMessage
methods.description: Attempts to retrieve the next message in the cache for a given cursor and updates cache pressure metrics.

methods.name: OnPurge
methods.description: Handles cache purge notifications, updates offset checkpoints, and logs cache periods.

methods.name: TryCalculateCachePressureContribution
methods.description: Calculates how close a message is to being purged based on its sequence token, contributing to cache pressure.

methods.name: GetSegment
methods.description: Allocates a buffer segment for message serialization, requesting new buffers as needed.

methods.name: LogDebugCachePeriod
methods.description: Logs details about cache enqueue and dequeue times for debugging cache performance.
